item.title: Cold Wave Sweeps J&K, Temperatures Dip Sharply Across Valley and Higher Reaches
item.description: SRINAGAR: Cold wave conditions intensified across Jammu & Kashmir as minimum temperatures fell sharply, plunging several parts of the Valley into severe sub-zero levels. Pulwama remained the coldest inhabited place at -5.5°C, followed by Shopian at -5.0°C. item.title: ED raids in multiple states in UP illegal cough syrup case

item.title: Rupee hits new record low; slumps 24 paise to 90.56/USD
item.description: MUMBAI: The rupee depreciated 24 paise to a new record low of 90.56 against US dollar in early trade on Friday, as uncertainty over the India-US trade deal and persistent foreign fund outflows dented investors’ sentiments. Forex traders said rupee is under pressure largely due to aggressive dollar purchases from importers amid surging global prices [...]
